title: Finish provider-neutral fetch and research quality audit
description: Audit direct fetch, PDF, captions, research budgets, output bounds, provenance, and cancellation against the extension scope. Add only required fixes and deterministic tests; keep browser/media/repository workflows with Pi or CLI tools.

logs.msg: Parent plan: audit fetch/research only within current extension scope; keep browser, repository, media, OCR, and vision workflows with Pi or CLI tools.

Audited fetch/research bounds, provenance, cancellation, and output paths. Added readable bounded research output including the safety prefix, provider identity on ResearchResponse, and preservation of provider warnings across sequential calls. Offline suite now passes 141 tests / 336 assertions.
